analysis: Source pass over .github/scripts/test-threat-budget.py (base text units :2 and :3; the head text is not supplied, only a truncated patch excerpt). The PR changes only the offline test harness: LocalService gains branch_version, write_barrier, barrier_writers, branch_conflicts, conflict_path and write_attempts fields, plus a simulated branch-level 409 in do_PUT. It also adds new tests (head ranges 143-191, 776-820) that appear to cover atomic budget reservation and state-branch write conflicts. No product code is touched: no provider, coordinator, key, attestation, cache or WebSocket logic, and no production secrets. The test fixture uses the synthetic token "synthetic" and a loopback-only 127.0.0.1 server. None of the canonical threat IDs (T-041, TB-002, TB-011 and the rest) are affected. No new attack surface or invalidated assumptions. Coverage limit: the patch excerpt is truncated, so the head-side tests at 143-191 and 758-820 were not seen in full. These are tests only, and I see no security impact. Integration should confirm that no non-test files (budget_runner, state) changed in other batches, since those would carry the actual ledger/spend-control security behavior.
